name: Card Dealer
one_line: A card table with a face-down deck, a fanned hand and a discard pile. Cards arc across the table between them and flip in flight, hop over each other when the hand is sorted, and lift on hover. Data-driven by each card's zone, with custom faces and backs, keyboard-playable hand cards and reduced-motion support.

verdict.reason: No job in Engrane — no surface in a maths-learning app needs it.
